memory_candidates.title: Lossy key projections make loop-guard inertness unprovable
memory_candidates.content: In a tableau loop-checking guard, if the recorded per-world key stores box-context in unwrapped form (psi for T(box psi)@w), the witness pair can collide with a box-context pair and the redirect-inertness obligation becomes FALSE, not merely unproven. Recording the boxed pair keeps the comparison plain key equality (so the freshness/pigeonhole chain survives) and makes inertness a direct consequence of the key-lower-bound invariant.

memory_candidates.title: Distinguish false lemma from unproven lemma before strengthening invariants
memory_candidates.content: Two dispatches were spent seeking an invariant strengthening for an obligation whose conclusion was false at a reachable state. A cheap executable probe that drives the actual stepper from the seed and prints every decidable hypothesis at each step settles reachability in one dispatch and rules out whole families of proposed repairs.

memory_candidates.title: Fuel-bounded drivers: exhaustion is a completeness not soundness risk
memory_candidates.content: When a tableau driver recurses structurally on fuel and its fuel=0 arm returns closed only from genuine closure checks, fuel exhaustion can never fabricate a closed verdict. Termination is free; the guard-sensitive quantity is fuel sufficiency, which is a completeness property. Predictions framed as 'termination rather than completeness' invert the dependency.

memory_candidates.title: A sorry standing in for a false statement is not a documented limitation
memory_candidates.content: When a divergence audit machine-checks a sorry-bearing lemma's conclusion as false at a reachable state (not merely unproven), removal -- not annotation -- is the correct response, even though the sorry was previously 'documented' with an inline writeup. A downstream consumer that composes the false lemma into a larger theorem inherits an unsound foundation that would still type-check, silently making the eventual soundness theorem worthless despite compiling cleanly.
